text.en:
On Weapon Kill:
+5 Range, +8 Stability, and -1.25% Accuracy Cone Size per stack. Precision Kills grant 2 Stacks. Maximum of 4 Stacks.

< table background_2 >
|b Stacks |b Stability |b Range |b Effective Range       |b Acc. Cone Size
|b 1x     |  8         |  5     |  <formula [range_0] /> | -1.25%
|b 2x     |  16        |  10    |  <formula [range_1] /> | -2.5%
|b 3x     |  24        |  15    |  <formula [range_2] /> | -3.75%
|b 4x     |  32        |  20    |  <formula [range_3] /> | -5%
<$>

Lasts 7 seconds. Refreshed on Kill.

enhanced (
#e Buff Duration is increased.
)
text.zh-chs:
使用此武器造成最后一击时：
+5 射程， +8 稳定性， -1.25% 精度锥角尺寸。精准击杀获取两层增益。增益最多叠加四层。

< table background_2 >
|b 增益层数 |b 稳定性     |b 射程  |b 有效射程               |b 精度锥角尺寸
|b 1x       |  8         |  5     |  <formula [range_0] /> | -1.25%
|b 2x       |  16        |  10    |  <formula [range_1] /> | -2.5%
|b 3x       |  24        |  15    |  <formula [range_2] /> | -3.75%
|b 4x       |  32        |  20    |  <formula [range_3] /> | -5%
<$>

持续 7 秒，击杀可刷新。

enhanced (
#e 延长增益持续时间。
)
